minimum_record: Released native CAD STEP drawings BOM and deviation register
acceptance_basis: All files share one revision and every make/buy item is identified

minimum_record: Measured report for every controlled interface
acceptance_basis: Drawing tolerances and interface-register closure criteria

minimum_record: Photos video and measured minimum clearances at load
acceptance_basis: No interference; agreed minimum clearance including tolerance and tyre deformation

minimum_record: Fixture description applied load duration deflection and permanent set
acceptance_basis: Supplier-proposed proof factor approved before test; no damage or unacceptable permanent set

minimum_record: Surface load speed stopping distance current and temperature log
acceptance_basis: Performance limits agreed at design freeze; stable controlled stop

minimum_record: Fault cases stopping result restart behaviour and contactor state
acceptance_basis: Motor-drive energy removed independently of software; controlled manual restart

minimum_record: Motor actuator bearing driver and battery temperatures with ambient
acceptance_basis: Component limits and agreed temperature-rise limits not exceeded

minimum_record: Measured mass properties tilt/load cases and arm configurations
acceptance_basis: Acceptance angles/margins agreed from intended operating conditions

test: Arm proof load and power-loss behaviour
minimum_record: Joint positions applied load deflection currents temperatures and drop behaviour
acceptance_basis: No uncontrolled hazardous drop; joint limits and agreed accuracy maintained
Tolerance agreed at design freeze and supported by raw measurements

minimum_record: Before/after optical datum measurement and vibration conditions
acceptance_basis: Calibration datum shift remains within agreed limit

minimum_record: Fastener schedule torque witness marks locking method and recheck
acceptance_basis: All safety/structural fasteners match released schedule

minimum_record: Pinch entanglement sharp-edge access and service checklist
acceptance_basis: All identified hazards guarded or documented for human review

minimum_record: Dimensional and functional results for agreed pilot quantity
acceptance_basis: No unresolved first-article deviation and stable build records

minimum_record: 5 m2 layout object mass spacing attempted and successful picks retries repositioning time run duration and replenishment method
acceptance_basis: User objective 50-100 successful deposits/minute; feasibility UNVERIFIED; supplier to propose achievable demo rate and agree test conditions

minimum_record: Firmware load or recovery procedure protocol/API/SDK pinout and buyer test command results
acceptance_basis: Buyer can load own software and control hardware through documented interfaces
